title: Diff-Instruct with Diffused Reward: Towards Principled One-step Generator RL
abstract: arXiv:2605.24001v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent advances in one-step text-to-image generation have enabled real-time synthesis with remarkable efficiency and quality. Previous reinforcement learning methods for one-step generators combine image-space reward optimization with diffusion noisy-space distribution matching. This paradigm brings challenges due to a mismatch between terminal reward optimization and the underlying generative dynamics. As a result, optimization tends to exploit stochastic degrees of freedom, often improving reward at the expense of image fidelity. To address this issue, we propose Diff-Instruct with Diffused Reward (DIDR), a data-free trajectory-level alignment framework derived from Integral KL minimization. DIDR propagates the RLHF-optimal reward-tilted clean-image distribution across all noise levels along the diffusion trajectory. translated_title: 基于扩散奖励的扩散指令：迈向有原则的一步生成器强化学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.24001v3 公告类型：replace-cross。摘要：一步式文本到图像生成的最新进展使实时合成兼具出色的效率与质量。以往面向一步生成器的强化学习方法将图像空间的奖励优化与扩散噪声空间的分布匹配相结合。然而，由于终端奖励优化与底层生成动力学之间的不匹配，这一范式带来了挑战。其结果是，优化过程往往倾向于利用随机自由度，常常以牺牲图像保真度为代价来换取奖励的提升。为解决这一问题，我们提出了基于扩散奖励的扩散指令（DIDR），这是一个源自积分 KL 散度最小化的免数据轨迹级对齐框架。DIDR 将 RLHF 最优的、经奖励倾斜的干净图像分布沿扩散轨迹传播至所有噪声水平上。我们证明该目标与干净图像 RLHF 具有相同的最小化器，同时自然地引出扩散（原文摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出 DIDR 框架，通过积分 KL 散度最小化，将 RLHF 最优的奖励倾斜干净图像分布沿扩散轨迹传播到所有噪声水平，解决了现有一步生成器强化学习中终端奖励优化与生成动力学不匹配导致以图像保真度换取奖励提升的问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes DIDR, a data-free trajectory-level alignment framework derived from Integral KL minimization that propagates the RLHF-optimal reward-tilted clean-image distribution across all noise levels along the diffusion trajectory, addressing the mismatch between terminal reward optimization and generative dynamics that causes fidelity loss in existing one-step generator RL methods.
